lines: This tiny engine beats an 8B-parameter LLM. And it's **11×** faster.
It cuts input tokens by 33.2%. Eight models agree on five datasets. Adobe Research proved it.
CSVs shrink from twenty-eight thousand to **three hundred** tokens. Logs drop ninety-nine point one percent small. No quality loss ever.
JetBrains tested eighty-six coding tasks. One line per phase, quiet tool runs. Payload stays verbatim.
Install via npx skills add JuliusBrussee caveman. It works in Claude Code and Gemini CLI too.
Send this to someone who writes code daily. Save for your next agent build.
